tech.headline: Anker’s new earbuds have the best call quality I’ve ever heard
tech.hook: The Liberty 5 Pro series are Soundcore’s most ambitious earbuds yet.
tech.summary: The Liberty 5 Pro series are Soundcore’s most ambitious earbuds yet. Soundcore, Anker's audio brand, has mostly lived in the budget-to-midrange world, but with its new Liberty 5 Pro earbuds, it's aiming at the big guys. The two new earbuds - the Liberty 5 Pro and Liberty 5 Pro Max - use Anker's new Thus chip , which has more processing power than previous Soundcore earbuds to try and compete with the chips found in Apple, Sony, and Bose products. And that extra processing power gives the Liberty 5 Pro the best in-call noise canceling I've heard in any earbuds. tech.headline: States ask judge to break up Live Nation-Ticketmaster
tech.hook: A federal judge is officially being tasked with deciding whether to break up Live Nation-Ticketmaster.
tech.summary: A federal judge is officially being tasked with deciding whether to break up Live Nation-Ticketmaster. More than 30 states are asking Judge Arun Subramanian to order a sale of the ticketing giant, a "sufficient number" of large amphitheaters, and limit its ability to tie access to its remaining amps to the use of its promotions services. In April, a jury found that the company is an illegal monopolist , after more than a month of trial.
